svg.title: Sylvan chart: collector choice at 8 µm
svg.text: Sylvan chart: collector choice at 8 µm
50 gr/ft³ at 8 µm: drop vertically to the efficiency bands
Dust-source zones of the printed chart are not redrawn
Drop vertically: LR cyclone < 50%; HE cyclone band ≈ 52–71% (cheapest unit for 70%, upper part of band);
wet collector ≈ 95–98%; cloth arrester and ESP ≈ 99%+ → for 98% a wet collector or cyclone + fabric filter/ESP.
Redrawn from Ludwig Vol. 1, Fig. 4-3 (Sylvan chart), digitized; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
